slides.title: coffee and a walk
slides.detail: drinks to go, one park loop. easy to stay longer or wrap it up early.

slides.title: a farmers market
slides.detail: stuff to point at and taste. snacks give you an instant topic.

slides.title: mini golf
slides.detail: a little competition breaks the ice. usually $10–15 each.

slides.title: a dessert crawl
slides.detail: two or three bakeries, split one thing at each. talk while you walk.

slides.title: bowling
slides.detail: shoes, a lane and something to do with your hands between turns.
